### The Core Value Proposition

Atlas integrates **directly into CI/CD pipelines** so LLM endpoint security testing happens **automatically at build time** — not as a periodic, manual review cycle bolted on after the fact.

This means every code push can trigger security validation of LLM endpoints **without a human in the loop**.

---

### How to Frame This for the DevOps Team

| Traditional Approach | Atlas Approach |
|---|---|
| Manual security reviews on a schedule | Automated testing on every push |
| Security bottlenecks deployment | Security runs *with* deployment |
| Issues found late in the cycle | Issues caught at build time |
